description: Anlon Healthcare Limited manufactures and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients in India and internationally. The company also offers bulk drugs; advanced pharmaceutical intermediates; nutraceutical API products; and drug intermediates. It also manufactures loxoprofen sodium dihydrate, ketoprofen, and dexketoprofen trometamol products for pain management and anti-inflammatory therapies. Anlon Healthcare Limited was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Rajkot, India.
